recipe.title: Quick Spiced Red Lentil and Potato Dal
recipe.description: A rich, aromatic stew featuring tender Yukon Gold potatoes and fast-cooking red split lentils simmered in coconut milk, garlic, and warm spices.

ingredients.item: Yukon Gold potatoes, diced into 1/2-inch cubes

instructions.text: Heat oil in a medium pot over medium heat. Add onion and sauté for 3 minutes until soft.
Stir in the garlic, ginger, curry powder, and cumin, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the diced potatoes, rinsed red lentils, and vegetable broth. Bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce heat to medium-low, cover with a lid, and simmer for 12 to 14 minutes until potatoes and lentils are tender.
Stir in coconut milk and spinach, allowing the spinach to wilt for 2 minutes.
Remove from heat, stir in lemon juice, season with salt and pepper, and garnish with fresh cilantro before serving.

tips: Dice the potatoes into small 1/2-inch cubes to ensure they cook completely in under 15 minutes.
Red lentils break down fast and naturally thicken the broth into a rich, velvety stew.
